name: OSAK custom firewall rules
description: OSAK-specific defense-in-depth rules. Cloudflare Access remains the primary admin service-token policy.

rules.description: OSAK admin paths require Cloudflare Access service-token headers
rules.expression: http.host eq "osak.lab.scogo.ai" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/admin/") and (not any(http.request.headers["cf-access-client-id"][*] ne "") or not any(http.request.headers["cf-access-client-secret"][*] ne ""))
